 11/19/2026 7:03 AM | Men's Basketball
 Utah Notes Share: The Utah men’s basketball will face Dayton (Nov. 20) and Minnesota (Nov. 22) this weekend at the Charleston Classic.
 Share: SALT LAKE CITY – The Utah men's basketball team flies East to play in the Charleston Classic for the first time since 2023. The Runnin' Utes are set to open the multi-team event with Dayton on Friday, Nov. 20, before facing Minnesota on Sunday, Nov. 22, inside TD Arena. Doug Sherman and Wake Forest star Randolph Childress will call the action both days on ESPN2.
 FEAST WEEK REWIND 
This will serve as Utah's second appearance in the Charleston Classic after going 1-2 in 2023. Utah defeated Wake Forest in its opening game behind a 31-point performance from Branden Carlson, 77-70. The Utes then dropped a rock fight against No. 6 Houston, 76-66, before falling to St. John's in another hard-fought battle inside TD Arena, 91-82.
 EYEING THE FLYERS 
Utah and Dayton have only squared off twice in program history with both occurring in the 1950s and on a neutral floor with the all-time series tied 1-1.  The last time the two teams battled, the Utes got the best of the 20th-ranked Flyers, 79-70, in New York on Dec. 29, 1958, as part of the Holiday Festival Tournament.
Dayton, who was ranked No. 4 at the time, won the first meeting between the two on Dec. 20, 1955, 77-73, in Lexington, Ky., as part of the Kentucky Tournament – which coincidentally had Utah battle Minnesota in the second game (L, 90-77).
 MEETINGS WITH MINNESOTA 
The match-up between Utah and Minnesota will be the sixth meeting all-time between the two teams with Utah leading the all-time series 3-2 after winning the most recent contest 73-69 in Salt Lake City on Nov. 15, 2019. However, the series is tied 1-1 when the two teams have battled it out on a neutral court. The Gophers took the first meeting in Lexington, Ky., 90-77 before the Runnin' Utes prevailed 75-72 in Raleigh, N.C., as part of the Dixie Classic on Dec. 29, 1959.
 HOME SWEET HOME 
This weekend's contests at the Charleston Classic for Utah against Dayton (Anthony Grant) and Minnesota (Niko Medved) will feature all three head coaches leading their Alma Mater.  
 UP NEXT 
Utah will now head home and get just over a week's worth of rest before starting a long homestand beginning with Cal on Wednesday, Dec. 2, at 7 p.m. (MT) on Peacock. The Runnin' Utes lead the all-time series 23-18 between the former Pac-12 rivals while also holding a 13-6 lead when playing at home. However, Cal got the upper-hand last season when the teams matched against each other in Berkeley, 79-72, but the Utes look to pick up their first win over Cal at home since March 2, 2024, which was the last conference home game for Utah as members of the Pac-12 Conference. The last time Utah defeated the Golden Bears at home in non-conference play dated back to Dec. 30, 1969 – a 96-77 affair in the first month of the Jon M. Huntsman Center opening.
 LOOKING AHEAD 
The long homestand continues for Utah as it welcomes in Cal Baptist for the second time in as many years on Wednesday, Dec. 9. The Utes bested the Lancers in their first meeting last season 91-85 inside the Jon M. Huntsman Center and look to make it two-in-a-row with Chris Sylvester and Joe Cravens guiding fans through the action beginning at 7 p.m. (MT) on ESPN+.
For the latest news and information on the Runnin' Utes men's basketball program, fans can stay connected online at www.UtahUtes.com and on social media by following @UtahMBB on Facebook , X and Instagram . Fans can also stay connected on their mobile devices or tablets with the Utah 360 app .
